title: Dungeon Quest IAP SKU reconciliation and replacement plan — v7

exact_mismatches.policy: Do not auto-delete or grant unknown identifiers. Resolve each mismatch against product metadata and observed wrapper flow.

replacement_principles: No gameplay-critical benefit remains real-money-only in the target test build.
Every permanent unlock is deterministic and persistent; paid random rolls are not required.
A product remains blocked from removal until its complete grant/effect is known.
Preserve receipt/history records; do not fabricate ownership or edit purchase receipts.
Economy values are proposals until playtested.
